name: Intercom Fin
shortDescription: Support agent priced from $0.99 per outcome and $19 per seat each month.
longDescription: Intercom's pricing page lists Fin AI Agent for customer support, from $0.99 per outcome and $19 per seat per month on the starter plan, and a higher seat price above that. It says to start a free trial but does not state the trial length.
pricingNotes: Pricing page: from $0.99 per Fin outcome and $19 per seat per month, with a free trial that has no stated length.
bestFor: A support inbox that wants an AI agent on top of Intercom seats
notIdealFor: A team that wants one flat price with no per-outcome fee
strength: Intercom lists Fin from $0.99 per outcome and a seat price of $19 per month on the starter plan.
weakness: The same page adds a per-outcome fee on top of the seat price, and it does not state how long the free trial lasts.

useCaseFit.customer-support: Sells a customer-support AI agent at $19 per seat per month plus $0.99 per outcome.
